liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cumberland Blues** (2 reviews): Energetic performance stands out alongside China Cat Sunflower and Here Comes Sunshine; Described as the hottest version ever recorded by a dedicated fan [10][12]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Considered the best live version of this song, a must-hear [18]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): An amazing early performance of this track is highlighted [18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Fluid transition into I Know You Rider separated by a sweet marmalade jam [11]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): A 69-minute jam sequence through Wharf Rat that did not disappoint [15]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Instrumental performance lacks verses, resulting in chaotic, melody-less jamming that disappoints [8]

## The recordings

- **gd73-11-14.sbd.vernon.5612.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 4.51/5 by 55 [1]. Said about its sound: Excellent audio quality with interesting jamming on the third disc; Sound quality exceeds that of the 11/11 and 11/17 recordings [9][16]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.hollister.14716.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Significantly better than circulating versions, with reduced static and pop artifacts [2]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.vernon.clevenger.fix-5612.6197.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1973-11-14.166344.aud.Conner.gems.flac1448**: audience recording; 26 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Charles recorded from center right with many police on the perimeter [4]
- Overshadowed by the preceding 11/11 show and the following 11/17 masterpiece [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-11-14.sbd.vernon.5612.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: SBD transferred via MR, cassette, DAT, CD to SHN by Matt Vernon [1]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.hollister.14716.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Hollister; source: 7" Master Reel > Cassette > CD [2]. Also: Cassette played on Nakamichi deck, transferred via Flying Calf A/D converter [2]
- **gd1973-11-14.sbd.vernon.clevenger.fix-5612.6197.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon and Bob Clevenger; source: SBD>MR>Cass>DAT>CDR [3]. Also: Bob Clevenger trimmed silence and minor tuning from set two tracks [3]
- **gd1973-11-14.166344.aud.Conner.gems.flac1448**: taped by Recorded by Charles Conner from center right; transferred by Mastering on November 13, 2023 by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain; source: Sony ECM-22P mic (mono)> Sony TC-55 > BASF C90 master cassettes [4]. Also: First audience recording circulated, shared on the 50th anniversary of the show [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by blogbujero.blogspot.com: [(000948)Grateful Dead San Diego Sports Arena, San Diego, CA 1973-11-14](https://blogbujero.blogspot.com/2022/09/grateful-dead-san-diego-sports-arena.html) [21]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead 30 Trips Around The Sun 1973 San Diego Sports Arena CA 11/14/73 | #4629811884](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-30-trips-around-sun-4629811884) [22]
- Fan art by Bob Morris Grateful Dead: [1973-11-14 San Diego Sports Arena, San Diego, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-11-14-san-diego-sports-arena-san-diego-ca-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by rirocks.net: [Grateful Dead 1973 09.14](https://rirocks.net/Band%20Articles/Grateful%20Dead%201973%2009.14%20-%20Prov.%20Civic%20Center.htm) [24]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 11/14/73 San Diego Sports Arena…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759945723/) [25]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/26759945723/) [26]
